description: Calculates the Belgian procedural indemnity (rechtsplegingsvergoeding / indemnité de procédure) for a claim: the minimum, base and maximum amounts in EUR, indexed for the given date. The result includes an explanation: the calculation steps (tariff, bracket, unindexed Royal Decree amounts, indexation), the judge's discretion under Article 1022 Judicial Code and, for a partly non-monetary claim, how the two tariffs compare. Use it to explain how and why the amount was reached.

amount.description: Amount in dispute in EUR. A number, or a Belgian-formatted string such as "2.500,50". Omit for a claim that cannot be valued in money.

court_type.description: Court/procedure type: "general" = General rate (art. 2 KB 26/10/2007): all courts and tribunals, including labour courts for e.g. employment-contract disputes. "voorzitter" = President of the Labour Court, proceedings under arts. 579 and 1017(2) Judicial Code (occupational accidents/diseases, social security). "arbeidsrechtbank" = Labour Court (arbeidsrechtbank / tribunal du travail), proceedings under arts. 579 and 1017(2) Judicial Code. "arbeidshof" = Labour Court of Appeal (arbeidshof / cour du travail), proceedings under arts. 579 and 1017(2) Judicial Code.

date.description: Optional reference date (YYYY-MM-DD), usually the date of the judgment. Defaults to today. Uses the indexation in force on that date.

locale.description: Language of the card and the calculator link. Always set it to the language the user writes in (nl, fr, de or en; use "en" for any other language). Defaults to "nl".

no_monetary_value.description: True when (part of) the claim cannot be valued in money. If an amount is also given, both the non-monetary amount and the amount bracket are returned.

name: calculate_rpv
title: Calculate rechtsplegingsvergoeding
